pages.text: Successfully contain an eligible creature in Holy Porcelain Pottery and release it again.

pages.title: Handle with Care
pages.text: Ordinary pottery supports further crafting and name tags distinguish safely relocated creatures.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Native size and blacklist rules apply. Do not use bosses or another player’s pets; select an eligible creature and a safe release site.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use Holy Porcelain Pottery to contain a creature. Native messages enforce size and blacklist eligibility rather than unlimited entity capture.
